# Michael Router

> One password-protected OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, included models, and free OpenRouter models.

- [Agent guide](https://michael-router.vercel.app/AGENTS.md): Instructions for coding agents.
- [Quick start](https://michael-router.vercel.app/): Connection setup and one request per provider.
- [API guide](https://michael-router.vercel.app/docs/api.html): Authentication, routing, streaming, and errors.
- [Tested models](https://michael-router.vercel.app/docs/providers.html): Live-tested IDs, including the two included models, and recommended defaults.

Recommended defaults: Claude `claude-opus-5-5`; OpenAI `gpt-6.1-sol`; Gemini `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`; OpenRouter `openrouter/free`.
Effort defaults to medium for Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini.
Set `"reasoning_effort": "low" | "medium" | "high"` to change it; higher costs more.
OpenRouter and the included models keep their own defaults.
Included models use exactly `kimi-k3.1-pro` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash`.
`automatic` tries `claude-opus-5-5`, then `gpt-6-astra`, then `deepseek-v4.1-flash` only for availability, rate or quota failure.
It skips missing keys and shared provider cooldowns. Explicit models have no fallback and bypass cooldowns.
Invalid requests, authentication, permission, context limits, safety refusals and successful replies stop the chain.
Fallback ends at the first client byte, including comments, role chunks and tool calls.
A committed stream ends with its terminal error on failure and never restarts.
The router never executes tools or replays streamed tool calls.
The concrete answering model appears in `model` and `x-router-model`; its provider appears in `x-router-provider`.
`x-router-fallback` lists earlier skips. `all_providers_unavailable` returns 503, or 429 if every failure was a rate limit.
Wait for `Retry-After`, the soonest known cooldown end, or 30 seconds if none is known.
Cooldowns honor valid upstream seconds or HTTP dates in full, with a 1 second minimum.
Missing or malformed values use 30 seconds. Extreme values are capped only at the largest representable end time.
Contact the owner to clear a stuck cooldown. Explicit model requests are never blocked by cooldowns.
Included models: zero marginal cost under a separate subscription plan, unmetered, still subject to the upstream provider's rate and capacity limits.
Group access being free does not make Claude or OpenAI calls free to Michael, the owner.
